tools.name: daily
tools.description: Token usage and cost grouped by day. Default source: all detected sources. Long ranges produce large JSON; prefer since/until or last.

sections.description: Emit multiple unified report sections from one load (daily, weekly, monthly, session) Comma-separated; each item one of: daily, weekly, monthly, session. Applies to: all.

by-agent.description: Include per-agent JSON breakdowns in unified report rows Default: false. Applies to: all.

offline.description: Use cached pricing data where supported Default: false.

no-cost.description: Hide cost information in table and JSON output Default: false. Applies to: all, codex, opencode, amp, droid, codebuff, hermes, pi, goose, kilo, copilot, gemini, antigravity, kimi, qwen, openclaw, grok, zcode.

config.description: Path to configuration file Default: auto-discovery.

last.description: Show only the most recent N periods of the report (1 is today, this week, or this month)

mode.description: Cost calculation mode Default: auto. Applies to: claude.

debug.description: Show pricing mismatch information for debugging Default: false. Applies to: claude.

debug-samples.description: Number of sample discrepancies to show in debug output Default: 5. Applies to: claude.

order.description: Sort order Default: asc. Applies to: claude.

breakdown.description: Show per-model cost breakdown Default: false. Applies to: claude.

single-thread.description: Disable parallel JSONL file loading Default: false. Applies to: claude.

instances.description: Show usage breakdown by project/instance Default: false. Applies to: claude.

project.description: Filter to specific project name Applies to: claude.

project-aliases.description: Comma-separated project aliases (e.g., 'ccusage=Usage Tracker,myproject=My Project') Applies to: claude.

speed.description: Cost speed tier: auto uses recorded settings, then Codex config.toml; use standard, flex, or fast to override Default: auto. Applies to: codex.

pi-path.description: Path or comma-separated paths to pi-agent sessions directories Applies to: pi.

open-claw-path.description: Path or comma-separated paths to OpenClaw data directories (default: ~/.openclaw, ~/.clawdbot, ~/.moltbot, ~/.moldbot) Applies to: openclaw.

tools.name: blocks
tools.description: Claude Code usage grouped by 5-hour billing blocks (Claude only).

debug.description: Show pricing mismatch information for debugging Default: false.

debug-samples.description: Number of sample discrepancies to show in debug output Default: 5.

breakdown.description: Show per-model cost breakdown Default: false.

offline.description: Use cached pricing data for Claude models instead of fetching from API Default: false.

single-thread.description: Disable parallel JSONL file loading Default: false.

timezone.description: Timezone for date grouping (e.g., UTC, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo) Default: system timezone.

config.description: Path to configuration file Default: auto-discovery.

active.description: Show only active block with projections Default: false.

recent.description: Show blocks from last 3 days (including active) Default: false.

token-limit.description: Token limit for quota warnings (e.g., 500000 or "max")

session-length.description: Session block duration in hours Default: 5.

tools.name: statusline
tools.description: Claude Code status line text for a hook payload (Claude only; returns plain text).

hook-input.description: Claude Code status-line hook payload (session_id, transcript_path, cwd, model, workspace, version, cost, context_window). Written to the engine's stdin unchanged.

offline.description: Use cached pricing data for Claude models instead of fetching from API Default: true.

visual-burn-rate.description: Controls the visualization of the burn rate status Default: off.

cache.description: Enable cache for status line output Default: true.

refresh-interval.description: Refresh interval in seconds for cache expiry Default: 1.

context-low-threshold.description: Context usage percentage below which status is shown in green (0-100) Default: 50.

context-medium-threshold.description: Context usage percentage below which status is shown in yellow (0-100) Default: 80.

config.description: Path to configuration file Default: auto-discovery.

debug.description: Show pricing mismatch information for debugging Default: false.

tools.name: list-sources
tools.description: List supported sources, their reports, and the server/engine versions and engine path (engine-error when the engine cannot be located or queried).

tools.name: report
tools.description: Run any ccusage report from CLI-style arguments; same validation as the typed tools.

args.description: CLI-style arguments as typed after `ccusage`, e.g. "codex daily --since 2026-10-01", "weekly --last 2 --by-agent", "" (= daily, all sources).
